referee_caveats_inferred: The ALMA-only result depends on imposed Gaussian and logistic priors, so the outer radius and flux there are prior-driven
The SMA-only flux (5.13 mJy) and ALMA prior (3.5 mJy) differ, so the joint fit depends on how the two datasets are weighted
The planet mass scales steeply with inner edge radius and uses one chaotic-zone formula at zero eccentricity
The 9 mm flux comes from a 3 sigma detection with aperture photometry and no model fit
The inclination and PA differ from Herschel values, and the paper leaves the physical origin unresolved
The spectral index conversion assumes beta_s = 1.8 and a single dust temperature
